intent.description: Use when governing Skill inventory, installation, updates, lightweight task acceptance, old-baseline cleanup, deduplication, activation, deactivation, relocation, or verification across user, workspace, workbench, and project scopes.
intent.job_to_be_done: Use when governing Skill inventory, installation, updates, lightweight task acceptance, old-baseline cleanup, deduplication, activation, deactivation, relocation, or verification across user, workspace, workbench, and project scopes.

should_trigger: 盘点这个 workspace 的 Skill，告诉我哪一份是 canonical
治理这个 workspace 的 Skill，先只读盘点，不要改
跟着上游把这几个技能升级到最新标签，按门禁走
复用这份验收证据，检查这个 Skill 的旧基线能不能退休清理
把项目作用域里这个 Skill 停用
同名 Skill 在几个作用域重复了，帮我去重
这个 Skill 的轻量验收怎么做，给我一个最小任务
audit my workspace skills and tell me which body is active
upgrade these skills to the latest upstream tag through the control plane
verify skill activation across user and project scopes
retire the old baseline of this skill after acceptance passed
migrate this skill activation to another workspace
should_not_trigger: 帮我写一个新 skill 来自动化日报
解释一下什么是 canonical body，不用动任何文件
把这份治理文档翻译成英文
发布这个 skill 到 GitHub
just explain how skill junctions work
brainstorm a brand-new skill idea with me
near_neighbor: 这个 Skill 的 README 帮我润色一下，别的不动
创建一个新的 qiaomu skill 并发布到 GitHub
评估一下这个 skill 的输出质量

execution.shell: pwsh or Windows PowerShell 5.1 for the bundled audit script

trust.remote_metadata_policy: read-only audit only; every mutation goes through the discovered control plane with preview

permissions.network: none required by the skill itself; upstream fetches belong to the workspace control plane
permissions.file_write: none by the audit script; mutations only through the discovered control plane after preview and decision
permissions.subprocess: read-only audit script; control-plane commands only as the workspace defines them
permissions.interactive: destructive or ambiguous boundary changes require an explicit human decision

scaffold: README hook and natural trigger examples
library: portability across user, workspace, workbench, and project scopes
trust boundary: audit read-only, mutations via control plane
governed: preview plus plan hash before every mutation
declaration and source-identity gates for upstream upgrades
acceptance evidence plus deletion authorization for retirement
public claim guard: evidence levels stay separate in reports

evidence_boundary.public_claim_policy: claim only what local validation, install proof, human review, or provider-backed evidence actually supports
